description: This grouped bar chart illustrates the number of datasets categorized by country or origin over a period of years. The horizontal axis, labeled "Year," displays chronological categories from 2012 to 2022. The vertical axis, labeled "Number of datasets," employs a logarithmic scale ranging from $10^0$ to $10^2$, with major tick marks and horizontal grid lines at intervals of powers of ten ($10^0$, $10^1$, $10^2$). Within each year on the horizontal axis, the data is represented by a grouped set of vertical bars, where each bar's color corresponds to a specific category defined in the legend: Other (blue), USA (orange), IN (green), UK (red), IT (purple), and DE (brown). The legend box also contains a solid grey rectangle at its top. The bars within each annual group are arranged side-by-side in the order presented by the legend, although not all categories are present in every year. The height of each bar indicates the dataset count on the logarithmic scale; the shortest visible bars rest exactly at the $10^0$ line (representing a value of 1), such as the USA bar in 2014, the DE bar in 2015, and the IN bar in 2017, while the tallest bar reaches slightly above $10^2$ (approximately 115) for the "Other" category in 2021. The bars for the final year, 2022, are visually distinguished from the rest of the chart by being rendered in faded, lighter shades of their respective category colors.
